replication_role: Independent system replication of the strongest Palmer result: progressive within-island concentration of breeding pairs beyond proportional thinning plus frozen count-error models.

provenance_boundary.consequence: This is a prospectively frozen analysis of a new Signy endpoint, but not a pristine untouched dataset.

source.dataset: Population size and breeding success of Adelie penguins on Signy Island from 1978 to 2020

rationale: CCAMLR-standardized monitoring began before this window.
The 1997 season is structurally incomplete because sea ice delayed station opening.
From 1998 the published source uses the pooled literal label A1 + A60.
A39 enters the monitored roster in 2011, so 2010 is the last season before that roster expansion.
primary_epoch.gate: Every primary season must contain a finite nonnegative breeding-pair count for exactly the expected literal roster; otherwise primary replication is not estimable and stops without changing the epoch.

metric.effective_colony_number: N_eff(t) = 1 / sum_j p_j(t)^2, where p_j(t) is colony j's share of total breeding pairs in season t.
metric.primary_statistic: OLS slope of N_eff against season_start_year over 1998-2010.

null.composition: Time-invariant cumulative colony shares estimated over the complete 1998-2010 primary epoch.
null.year_totals: Preserve the observed Signy total breeding-pair trajectory as the latent yearly total.
null.positive_total_conditioning: For any observed-positive season, redraw simulated colony counts if the simulated island total is zero.

decision.per_model_p: (1 + number of simulated slopes <= observed slope)/(B+1)
decision.replication_supported: Observed slope must be negative and one-sided p <= 0.05 under all three frozen count-error models.

later_epoch.role: Descriptive/sensitivity epoch after A39 enters the monitored roster.
later_epoch.rule: Report the same N_eff slope only if that epoch has a fixed complete literal roster; it cannot rescue a failed 1998-2010 primary result.

terminal_rules: Do not split the published A1 + A60 pooled label.
Do not drop low-count or zero-count colonies from the fixed roster.
Do not tune the start/end year after observing N_eff.
Do not substitute active-colony count, Shannon diversity, Gini, thresholded colony count, or another concentration metric if the primary test fails.
Do not introduce alternative count-error CV values without independent observer-error calibration.
If supported, claim replicated within-island breeding-space concentration during decline, not individual dispersal, habitat causation, Allee effects, or public-information use.
